plugin.name: xfwm-decoration
plugin._long: Window frames drawn from xfwm4 themes (b6, b6+, b6+r, b5+, crux). Use it instead of the decoration plugin.

option.name: theme
option._long: The name of the theme: a folder with a themerc in b6-themes (~/.local/share/b6-themes, /usr/share/b6-themes or the themes path).

option.name: themes_path
option._long: Extra folders that hold themes, separated by colons. They are looked in before the data folders.

option.name: window_color
option._long: The window color of your color scheme as #RRGGBB, e.g. #2a2e32. A dark one gives the frames dark borders; empty keeps the theme as drawn.

option.name: font
option._long: The font of the window titles, as a Pango font description.

option.name: double_click
option._short: Double click on the title bar
option._long: What a double click on the title bar does: minimize, maximize or none.

option.name: ignore_views
option._short: Decoration disabled for specified window types
option._long: Disables window decoration for windows matching the specified criteria.

option.name: forced_views
option._short: Force decorations for specified window types
option._long: Forces window decoration for windows matching the specified criteria, overriding client decoration preference.
